refsection.title: Description
refsection.para:
The `SilikoSyntaxTreeNewFromInteger` function generates a new leaf node from an integer value.
* `IntegerValue` is the value to be stored in the leaf node.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: `SilikoSyntaxTreeNewFromInteger` returns a pointer to a new leaf `SilikoSyntaxTreeNode` object with the value passed on success, or `NULL` if there was a memory error.
